concept: Stage portal in a carved timber hollow
creativeDirection: A tactile mixed-media relief collage combining linocut woodgrain, cut paper portraiture, and hand-painted leather textures.
scene: Front-facing view into a giant upright wood cross-section transformed into a shallow theatrical niche, as if a carved tree trunk has opened to reveal a tiny interior stage.

elements.element: A single central female figure with long straight platinum-blonde hair, a small yellow hair clip, and a black leather jacket accented by red, white, and grey zigzag trim.
A secondary male figure emerging from shadow at one side, head lowered, one arm lifted near his collar, with a dangling cross earring and black leather jacket shaping the darker edge of the scene.
The entire setting built from a wood cross-section with concentric rings, rough bark, and a miniature forest path receding through the hollow center, rendered in woodcut-like linework.

coverSummaries.description: A studio portrait of a woman shown from the chest up against a plain light grey background. She faces forward with a neutral expression, long straight platinum-blonde hair, and a small yellow hair clip near the top right side of her hair. She wears a black leather jacket with bold red, white, and grey zigzag or lightning-like trim, with a dark top visible underneath. The composition is centered and tightly cropped around her face and upper torso.
coverSummaries.signatureMotif: long straight platinum-blonde hair with a small yellow hair clip

coverSummaries.description: A close-up color photograph of a man in a dramatic pose, cropped tightly around his head, shoulder, and hand. He wears a black leather jacket and raises one arm over his head while gripping the jacket collar or lapel with the other hand. His face is partly shadowed and turned downward, with short dark hair, facial stubble, and a dangling cross earring. A blue background appears along the left edge, while the rest of the image is dominated by dark clothing and warm skin tones.
coverSummaries.signatureMotif: dangling cross earring beside a shadowed face in a black leather jacket

coverSummaries.description: A black-and-white illustration on a white background showing a circular cross-section of wood or a hollow log. The concentric rings and rough bark form an oval frame around a small forest scene visible in the center, with trees and a path receding inward. A flower with leaves grows from the left side of the wood form. The composition is centered with large areas of blank white space around the detailed ink image.
coverSummaries.signatureMotif: wood cross-section framing a forest interior

prompt: Front-facing view into a giant upright wood cross-section that has been carved open into a shallow theatrical niche, the concentric rings and rough bark forming an oval proscenium around a tiny forest path receding inward through the hollow center; at center stage, one woman shown from the chest up, facing forward with calm authority, long straight platinum-blonde hair falling cleanly over a black leather jacket marked by bold red, white, and grey zigzag trim, a small yellow hair clip near the top right side of her hair as a bright accent; at the shadowed right edge of the timber niche, a man appears only once as a supporting figure, head turned downward, one arm raised near his collar in a dramatic pose, black leather jacket merging into darkness, facial stubble and a single dangling cross earring catching light, with a slim wedge of deep blue tucked behind him; use the wood cross-section and bark from the third source as the full architectural frame, with woodcut-style ink lines describing the rings, bark, and miniature interior forest, and let a small flower with leaves sprout subtly from the left side of the timber rim; mixed-media relief collage, combining linocut and woodcut mark-making for the tree and forest, cut-paper portrait shapes, matte gouache-painted leather textures, and slight shadow-casting layered surfaces; strong visual hierarchy with the blonde figure dominant, the wood portal second, and the male figure as a dark counterweight, centered composition with generous breathing room around the oval form, soft directional light from upper left creating tactile depth and a shrine-like focus; palette of bone white, ink black, weathered grey, platinum blonde, cobalt blue, oxblood red, muted tan, and a pinpoint yellow accent, mood enigmatic, intimate, and ceremonial. Hard constraints (override any conflicting source material): Create a single cohesive 16:9 image, not a grid, contact sheet, row of covers, or collage of separate panels. Do not reproduce the album sleeves as framed thumbnails; transform their non-text visual motifs into one original composition. Include no readable text or lettering of any kind: no words, letters, numbers, code, glyphs, captions, titles, logos, watermarks, labels, or signage. Feature only adults and avoid gore, wounds, body horror, medical or anatomical imagery, blank or milky eyes, nudity, sexual content, weapons, and hate symbols; reinterpret any sensitive source motif abstractly. When a source includes a person, closely match their visible appearance and likeness to the reference image, preserving recognisable facial features, hair, skin tone, clothing, and styling. Depict each identifiable reference person only once in the entire composition; do not repeat or clone them as another figure, reflection, mirror portrait, poster, billboard, screen, photograph, painting, silhouette, or background face. The only exception is repetition visibly intrinsic to one source cover: keep that repetition within that single source motif and do not echo the person elsewhere.
